name: app-store-connect-cli-skills
title_zh: App Store 上架、改价、查状态
tagline_zh: 不用再开 App Store Connect 网页点点点。发版、改审核信息、查状态、管 TestFlight。
tagline_en: Stop clicking through App Store Connect. Release, edit metadata, check status, manage TestFlight—all scriptable.
desc_en: Skills to automate app store deployed and everything related to it using the asc cli
why_zh: 把 asc 官方 CLI 包成一组可组合的 skill，省去查文档和拼参数的时间。命令即流程。
why_en: Wraps the official asc CLI into composable skills—no doc-hunting, no flag-fumbling. Commands become repeatable flows, built for.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 asc CLI 已支持的操作，不处理 App Store Connect 网页端独有功能（如部分协议签署）。
limit_en: Only covers asc CLI capabilities; no web-only features (e.g., some agreements). Requires asc CLI installed & logged in, plus dev account access.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Ship, price & track App Store releases from terminal
